title: A man named Bernie proposes ESP as a savant skill in non-speaking autistic people

tellings.quote: who first kind of came up with this idea that that maybe tele not telepathy but ESP gifts are should be a savant skill

plain: A man known only as Bernie was the first to suggest that ESP (extrasensory perception, meaning knowing things without the usual senses) should be seen as a savant skill in some autistic people who do not speak. That is what Ky Dickens, the maker of a documentary on telepathy in non-speaking children, tells Michels. She does not name a source beyond Bernie himself, and his idea would put such gifts alongside other rare savant talents.
